summary: Two-minute ops sync immediately after Richard closed a prospect. Richard asks whether a Klarna payment came through and whether Klarna fires the Slack automation automatically; Angelo confirms the automation did not fire and that he will send the agreement manually. They confirm the amount as 3K and agree Klarna counts as a 'piff' (paid in full). Angelo instructs Richard to book the onboarding call using the Kettlebell Body Lite specific onboarding link.
notable: Stated internal policy: a Klarna instalment purchase is counted as a 'piff' (paid in full) — 'Does Klarna count as a piff?' / 'Yep.'
Confirms a productised lower tier exists with its own onboarding path: 'the Kettlebell Body Lite specific onboarding link'.
Amount referenced is 3K, which is not one of the two documented offer prices ($6,000/6mo, $9,000/12mo).

Payment automation did not fire on a Klarna transaction — 'I don't think that it fired' — agreement email had to be sent manually, meaning onboarding steps are not reliably automated for this payment method.

This call is the continuation of the Dhairya Nanda sales call recorded two minutes earlier (2026-07-30_dhairya-nanda_richard-claessen), where Richard said he would 'quickly call someone' about the missing email.
